You will also work with Waymo’s Field Safety team in the United States to identify and analyze issues that could impact the safety of Waymo’s fleet of autonomous vehicles, with a focus on issues specific to Waymo’s operations in the United Kingdom.

• Ability to work occasionally in the evenings to collaborate with the US-based Field Safety team.

• Experience interacting with automotive and traffic safety regulators.

• Familiarity with autonomous vehicle technology.

• Experience working in a fast-paced, rapidly-scaling company.
